title: Thermomix Mexican Beef Bowls
description: The steps are from Thermobliss. Beef, stock and tomato paste amounts were estimated for a 4-serve batch, so confirm at the source.

confidence.note: The steps are from Thermobliss. Beef, stock and tomato paste amounts were estimated for a 4-serve batch, so confirm at the source.

items.item: Mexican rice, baby spinach, avocado, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, grated cheese, corn chips, sour cream

steps.text: Toss the beef ({{beef}}) in the paprika ({{paprika}}), cumin ({{cumin}}) and chilli ({{chilli}}, if using) until well coated.
Add the red onion ({{onion}}) to the bowl. Chop 3 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down.
Add the olive oil ({{oil}}) and garlic ({{garlic}}). Sauté 3 min / Varoma / Speed 1.
Add the stock ({{stock}}). Place the spiced beef in the simmering basket, insert into the bowl, and cook 25 min / Varoma / Speed 1.
Remove the basket and set the beef aside. Discard about three-quarters of the liquid.
Return the beef to the bowl with the tomato paste ({{tomato-paste}}). Shred 10 sec / Reverse / Speed 4. Check the seasoning.
Serve over Mexican rice and build each bowl with the toppings.

notes.title: Tip
notes.text: Omit the chilli for kids. The shredded beef is also good in tacos, burritos or baked potatoes.
